title: Spoken Word Slam
description: An electrifying evening of poetry, prose, and performance where students compete for the coveted Golden Quill Award in front of a live audience.

title: Author's Afternoon
description: An intimate roundtable with guest authors discussing their creative journeys, writing rituals, and the stories behind their most beloved works.

title: Debate Royale
description: Teams of two face off in a high-stakes British Parliamentary debate on contemporary literature's role in shaping social discourse and identity.

title: Flash Fiction Festival
description: Writers crafted compelling 500-word stories live on stage. The crowd roared for three finalists whose tales left no dry eye in the house.

title: Lit Trivia Night
description: Teams battle through six rounds of literature trivia spanning classics, contemporary fiction, poetry, and Nobel laureates. Twenty-four teams, one crown.

title: Screenplay Workshop
description: A two-day intensive workshop on screenplay writing led by a visiting screenwriter. Participants pitched original pilots to a panel of faculty judges.
